task_summary: Executed 100% database purge across all 24 MongoDB collections, flushed Redis, wiped MinIO storage, and registered 1 active, verified Instructor account (instructor@buksu.edu.ph) with academic foundation (2025-2026, BSIT, BSIT-4A) and singleton SystemSettings. Verified live authentication returning 200 OK with valid JWT.
lessons_learned: Lesson: Mongoose pre('save') hook in user.model.js automatically generates salt and hashes plaintext password; passing an already-hashed password to User.create triggers the hook again, causing double-hashing and subsequent 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS failures on login.

Prevention: When creating users through Mongoose models (User.create), pass the plaintext password directly so the model pre-save hook executes exactly once. If using pre-hashed strings, use raw collection insert (db.collection('users').insertOne).

Runbook / Checklist for Clean Database Reset: 1. Disconnect or flush active Redis keys to clear queued BullMQ jobs. 2. Delete all documents in all non-system MongoDB collections. 3. Re-initialize singleton SystemSettings (key: 'global') and baseline academic entities (AcademicYear, Course, Section) with createdBy set to the initial admin/instructor ID to prevent client UI null-reference crashes. 4. Probe POST /api/auth/login to verify authentication evidence before releasing.
